new.name: Table footnote text spliced into a table row
new.page_shows: Row 10.0 reads 'Details regarding any unsuccessful pressure tests, including the cause of the test failure'; the footnote 'The hydro-testing contractor provided all hydro-test fluid and trucked it away for re-use or disposal at its facility.' sits in a separate line under the table, attached to row 6.0 (N/A1)
new.output_says: | 10.0 Details including 1 The hydro-testing | regarding any unsuccessful pressure tests, the cause of the test failure contractor provided all hydro-test fluid and trucked it | Test Documentation away for re-use or disposal at its facility. | C |
new.why_it_matters: The footnote words are woven into the wording of requirement 10.0 and the row's cells, and cells shift; a search or AI reads the requirement as 'Details including 1 The hydro-testing ... contractor provided all hydro-test fluid', and the footnote no longer belongs to row 6.0 (permits for water disposal)
new.lesson: Treat a table's footer line as a note tied to its marker (N/A1), not as a table row; keep marker-to-note links

new.name: Table-of-contents section numbers taken for margin line numbers

new.name: Plain body paragraphs promoted to headings
new.page_shows: Three ordinary body paragraphs (project summary text) with no bold or numbering; only the title lines are headings
new.output_says: ## In its project application [Filing A81054], Manitoba Hydro is proposing to construct and operate ... ## Based on the proposed design and route, the construction of the Dorsey IPL will require alterations ...
new.why_it_matters: The whole body becomes sections; heading-based chunking and outlines treat paragraphs as titles, the summary has no body text under its heading

new.name: Check-box widget contradicts the drawn tick
new.page_shows: 'The wetland is not fish bearing and there are no potential impacts...' has a ticked box; 'Wetland ... crossed in accessing the site' answer is No (ticked)
new.output_says: ☐ [The wetland is not fish bearing and there are no potential impacts to fish or fish habitat ...] and ☐ [☑ No]; also ☐ [Creek 6 m] and the River/Lake/Creek/Slough/Wetland options listed twice
new.why_it_matters: The form widget layer says 'unchecked' where the visible page says checked, and the label of one option absorbs a neighbouring value ('Creek 6 m'); an AI cannot tell which answer was given, and a reader finds a no-fish statement marked unchecked
new.lesson: Read check state from the drawn mark and widget together, flag conflicts; never let a checkbox label swallow adjacent values; do not repeat options for each repeated group without its group label

new.name: Tracked-change digits fused into coordinates

new.lesson: Resolve tracked changes (keep inserted, drop struck) or flag them; file the clean final
